notes: Both round 0 fixes are in. V1: the cut line is gone and the paragraphs are regrouped. V2: the vague 'Each team was set to build for a nonprofit' is cut and the Movers & Makers credit is kept. All 5 source_quotes the draft relies on (F3, F4, F7, F8, F10) were found word for word in the post. LinkedIn uses 5 distinct fact ids and Instagram uses 4, both within the density limits. Both platforms use 'we' and 'you'. Nothing states attendance, winners or results for the 2025 event, and there is no expired call to action. No definitions are used and no sentence is mapped to DEF. Every sentence passed every check, so the verdict is PASS.
